title: Tiny, cute book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cover' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b83a3a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e05a5a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- back cover peeking -->
  <rect x='22' y='26' width='58' height='52' rx='4' fill='#8c2a2a'/>
  <!-- pages -->
  <rect x='26' y='24' width='54' height='52' rx='3' fill='#fdf2d6'/>
  <rect x='27' y='25' width='52' height='50' rx='3' fill='#fffaf0'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='33' y1='36' x2='73' y2='36' stroke='#e6cfa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='44' x2='73' y2='44' stroke='#e6cfa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='52' x2='67' y2='52' stroke='#e6cfa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='60' x2='70' y2='60' stroke='#e6cfa0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front cover left half -->
  <rect x='20' y='22' width='32' height='54' rx='4' fill='url(#cover)'/>
  <!-- spine -->
  <rect x='20' y='22' width='7' height='54' rx='3' fill='#8c2a2a'/>
  <!-- cover decoration: little heart -->
  <path d='M33 40 C30 35 24 37 25 43 C26 48 33 52 33 52 C33 52 40 48 41 43 C42 37 36 35 33 40 Z' fill='#ffd9d9'/>
  <!-- bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d='M56 76 L56 60 L64 66 L64 76 Z' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <path d='M56 76 L60 72 L64 76 Z' fill='#e0b030'/>
</svg>
